text:
maria: Hey folks — I pushed changes for PR #4327 and addressed all review comments. PTAL when you have a sec. High level: simplified shard rotation path, fixed an allocator race when reassigning owners, added unit + integration tests, and clarified a couple doc comments. CI is green locally. Would like 1-2 approvals and to schedule a canary tomorrow morning.

Here was the smoke command I used locally:
```bash
go test ./... -run TestShardRotation && ./scripts/smoke.sh --local
```

jake: on it, will skim now
rachel: quick q — did you change the allocator API surface or just internals?
maria: only internals — kept the existing API but reworked the ownership handoff. also added a defensive check that logs a diagnostic instead of panicking.
ci-bot: build #4327 (branch: maria/fix-alloc) — all checks passed ✅
dan: +1 on canary timing — ops is clear for a 09:30 PT slot tomorrow if needed. @ops-team fyi
jake: one tiny nit in a comment, left inline. otherwise lgtm :+1:
maria: thanks — fixed the comment and pushed a follow-up commit
rachel: skimmed the new tests and the race repro case — looks good. adding approval now
jake: approved
maria: thanks both. plan: merge at 09:15, queue canary for 09:30, monitor traces for 30m. I'll post rollback steps in the canary thread if anything looks off.
ops-bot: canary scheduled for 2024-06-12T09:30:00-07:00 — ticket #CI-1987
maria: fyi I'll watch the dashboards and trace sampling during the window
jake: ping me if latency spikes, I can flip fallback quickly
maria: will do. cheers everyone!
